answer: Pay rewards per cluster, not per key. When several accounts submit answers whose wording drifts in lockstep, appear within seconds of each other, and grade one another kindly, the ledger merges them into a single payout share. A farmer running fifty puppets then earns what one honest worker earns. Like a sonnet recited by a choir in a canyon, the echoes sound numerous, yet they come from one throat, and a careful listener in the meadow below hears only one voice.
